text:
maria: starting a small probe to roll up TTFT by route + kernel. want to capture TTFT vs decode attribution without blowing up our telemetry volume.

ash: 1% sampling by token might be too heavy for top routes. can we do per-route qps-based sampling? e.g. min(1%, 1000/route_qps)

jake: +1 to adaptive sampling. also need tags: route, model, kernel_selector, kv_hit. without kv_hit we can't separate cold vs warm.

lina: i'd prefer summarized rollups (quantiles + hist buckets) shipped to clickhouse and only full traces for sampled tokens to s3. omit big things like raw prompt text in the full trace.

sam: i can add a 'ttft_rollup' mode to probe agent. plan:
```yaml
mode: ttft_rollup
sample_rate: 0.01 # default
adaptive: true
route_thresholds:
  high_qps: 0.001
  low_qps: 0.05
fields:
  - ttft_ms
  - decode_ms
  - kernel_ms
  - kv_hit
  - kernel_choice
sink:
  rollup: clickhouse.ttft_rollups
  full_samples: s3://runtime-probes/ttft-samples/
```
will gzip and proto-encode to keep size small.

ash: that config looks good. make sure adaptive sampling respects customer tier (dedicated/private => lower sampling). maybe add route_whitelist for debug.

maria: important: define kernel_ms precisely. runtime currently reports kernel_time as sum of all kernel launches. need to align with probe's kernel timing to avoid double count with scheduling time.

jake: suggestion: expose three fields: kernel_exec_ms, kernel_queue_ms, kv_lookup_ms. then rollups can attribute.

lina: question about dashboards: we should store rollups per minute per route+kernel+kv_hit. that gives us p50/p90/p99 and token count.

maria: agreed. add a per-route KPI: token_slices_per_second, avg_ttft_ms, kv_hit_rate. also a synthetic alert: p99_ttft increases >20% vs baseline for 5m.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled by sam at 2026-04-02T18:30:00Z :rocket:

sam: deploying probe changes to canary hosts now. will monitor ingress CPU and clickhouse write QPS. ping me if you see >3% CPU delta.

jake: can you post quick queries? e.g. clickhouse:
```sql
SELECT
  route,
  kernel_choice,
  kv_hit,
  quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms) AS p50,
  quantile(0.9)(ttft_ms) AS p90,
  quantile(0.99)(ttft_ms) AS p99
FROM ttft_rollups
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
GROUP BY route, kernel_choice, kv_hit
ORDER BY p99 DESC
LIMIT 50
```

lina: nice. add token_count and sample_rate to results so we can reason about sampling noise.

ash: follow-up: let's make sample_rate dense for failed infer requests (status != 200) to capture regressions.

maria: good call. capture error_code and make sample_rate_for_errors = 1.0.

sam: can confirm canary is up. initial metrics look sane. clickhouse writes ~1200 rows/min. CPU +0.6% on canaries.

maria: thanks. timeline: canary 30m, then 3% of hosts for 2h, then full roll. i'll open a follow-up thread for dashboard panels and alert rules.

ash: I'll draft alert thresholds and post them in ops-alerts.

jake: LGTM. small ask: include a stable metric name mapping doc so console dashboards can import. same naming conventions as existing token_*.

maria: copied. thanks all :thumbsup:
